observations.description: No orders/fills created; advisory_only=True, live_trading_permitted=False, trading_authority=False. No network/credential imports.
Every fill retained in valid PaperGatewaySnapshotV1: missing order rejects, cancel event rejects, wrong fill_id/quantity/market all reject. Binding identity is SHA-256.
Idempotent fill and mark replay: exact replay returns self (no-op). Mark replay is idempotent.
Ledger immutable, tamper detection via identity mismatch, deterministic replay, fill bindings must be tuple.
Marks require exact market/instrument/contract identity. Wrong market rejects. Mark produces unrealized P&L from fill price, not notional.
Gateway reconciliation detects missing accounted fill and filled-quantity divergence.
BTC-only: non-BTC accounting rejects. Empty accounting required for new ledger.
Exact Decimal costs: commission=1, exchange_fee=2, slippage=0, total=3, cash=4997. No P&L inferred from notional (unrealized=0 before mark).
Sell/short behavior: sell fill enters accounting with negative position. No notional inference: costs from FillEconomicsV2, not from order notional.
